definitions.explanation: a premium railway car on Japanese trains offering more comfortable seating and less crowding for an additional fare

examples.japanese: グリーン{車|しゃ}に{乗|の}った。
examples.english: I rode in the first-class car.

examples.japanese: グリーン{車|しゃ}は{空|す}いていて{快適|かいてき}だ。
examples.english: The first-class car is empty and comfortable.

examples.japanese: {新幹線|しんかんせん}のグリーン{車|しゃ}は{座席|ざせき}が{広|ひろ}い。
examples.english: The seats in the Shinkansen first-class car are spacious.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
From 「グリーン」 (green) + {車|しゃ} (car)
The name comes from the green clover symbol used to mark these cars.

FEATURES:
- Larger, more comfortable seats
- More legroom
- Less crowding
- Additional fare required (グリーン{料金|りょうきん})

VARIATIONS:
- {新幹線|しんかんせん}のグリーン{車|しゃ} - Shinkansen first class
- {普通|ふつう}グリーン{車|しゃ} - First class on local trains
- グランクラス - super first class (even higher tier)

CONTRAST:
- グリーン{車|しゃ} ↔ {普通車|ふつうしゃ} (regular car)
- グリーン{車|しゃ} ↔ {自由席|じゆうせき} (unreserved seating)
